name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
                           Regular Gray-Scott Reaction-Diffusion, with reagents added for F, K, D_a and D_b.
      The extra reagents each have a decay speed and a diffusion rate.
      
      A mixable amount of these is used in the main formula, so that accumulation behaviour can be tuned before engaging its effect.
      
      The difference (a - b) and the b reagent, can be used to 'emit' value into the extra reagents.
      
      Emission amplitude is scaled by ctrlAmp and the decay rates are scaled by decayAmp.
      
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.8
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.4
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.065
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.059
      </param>
      <param name="ctrlAmp">
        0.026
      </param>
      <param name="decayAmp">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="fDecay">
        0.0001
      </param>
      <param name="kDecay">
        0.0032
      </param>
      <param name="daDecay">
        0.002
      </param>
      <param name="dbDecay">
        0.00023
      </param>
      <param name="fEffect">
        0.24
      </param>
      <param name="kEffect">
        -0.01
      </param>
      <param name="daEffect">
        1.2
      </param>
      <param name="dbEffect">
        0.5
      </param>
      <param name="diffToF">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="diffToK">
        -0.2
      </param>
      <param name="diffToDa">
        0.09
      </param>
      <param name="diffToDb">
        0.002
      </param>
      <param name="bToF">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="bToK">
        0.22
      </param>
      <param name="bToDa">
        0.07
      </param>
      <param name="bToDb">
        0.011
      </param>
      <param name="D_F">
        0.007
      </param>
      <param name="D_k">
        0.0011
      </param>
      <param name="D_Da">
        0.0358
      </param>
      <param name="D_Db">
        5e-06
      </param>
      <param name="powF">
        1.00005
      </param>
      <param name="powK">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="powDa">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="powDb">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="6">
        c = pow( D_F * laplacian_c + (1.0 - fDecay * decayAmp) * c, powF );
        d = pow( D_k * laplacian_d + (1.0 - kDecay * decayAmp) * d, powK );
        e = pow( D_Da * laplacian_e + (1.0 - daDecay * decayAmp) * e, powDa);
        f = pow( D_Db * laplacian_f + (1.0 - dbDecay * decayAmp) * f, powDb);
        
        delta_a = (D_a + e * daEffect) * laplacian_a - a*b*b + ( F + fEffect * c ) * (1.0f-a);
        delta_b = (D_b + f * dbEffect) * laplacian_b + a*b*b - ( ( F + fEffect * c ) + ( k + kEffect * d ) ) * b;
        
        delta_c = ctrlAmp * diffToF * ((1.0 - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToF;
        delta_d = ctrlAmp * diffToK * ((1.0 - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToK ;
        delta_e = ctrlAmp * diffToDa * ((1.0 - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToDa;
        delta_f = ctrlAmp * diffToDb * ((1.0 - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToDb;
        
      </formula>
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <constant value="1">
        </constant>
        <everywhere>
        </everywhere>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="0" high="1">
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.6">
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0.8">
          </point3D>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <subtract>
        </subtract>
        <other_chemical chemical="b">
        </other_chemical>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.6">
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0.8">
          </point3D>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="false">
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="false">
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="b">
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="0">
      </low>
      <high value="1">
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="15">
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="0.25">
      </contour_level>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
      </show_bounding_box>
      <slice_3D value="true">
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">
      </slice_3D_position>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">
      </show_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true">
      </color_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true">
      </use_image_interpolation>
      <timesteps_per_render value="333">
      </timesteps_per_render>
      <show_phase_plot value="false">
      </show_phase_plot>
      <phase_plot_x_axis value="a">
      </phase_plot_x_axis>
      <phase_plot_y_axis value="b">
      </phase_plot_y_axis>
      <phase_plot_z_axis value="c">
      </phase_plot_z_axis>
    </render_settings>
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 511 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
